# Security reporting

Report suspected vulnerabilities privately through this repository's
[Security tab](https://github.com/Antrakt92/vortex-nexus-modding-mcp/security), using
**Report a vulnerability**. Do not post credentials or exploit details in a public issue.

Include the affected release or commit, component, minimal reproduction,
expected boundary and possible impact. Use synthetic data where possible.
Never send a bearer token, Nexus API key, credential store, account export or
Vortex database.

Examples include authentication bypasses, credential leaks, unsafe file paths
and operations that can run twice after an interrupted request.
Ordinary bugs and setup questions belong in
[Issues](https://github.com/Antrakt92/vortex-nexus-modding-mcp/issues/new/choose).
